help.race:
ROM 有以下可选种族：
  人类  标准种族
  矮人  优秀的战士和牧师，创建消耔8点
  精灵  优秀的盗贼和法师，创建消耔5点
  巨人  巨大的、强壮的战士，创建消耔6点

不同种族有不同的初始属性和属性上限。
创建消耔会增加升级所需的经验值。
更多信息请查看各种族的帮助（如 'help dwarf'）
help.human:
人类是世界上最常见的种族，占据了冒险者的大多数。
虽然他们没有其他种族的特殊天赋，但他们更加全能，
擅长所有四个职业。人类也可以将主要属性训练得比其他
种族更高，并且能从魔法设备中获得更多好处。
help.dwarf:
矮人是个子矮小、结实 robust 的半人类，以暴戾的脾气和
强大的耐力闻名。矮人拥有高力量和体质，但敏捷较差。
他们不如人类聪明，但因长寿而通常更智慧。矮人是出色
的战士和牧师，但很差的法师或盗贼。

矮人对毒素和疾病有很强的抵抗力，但不会游泳，
因此很容易淹死。他们免费获得狂暴技能（战士），
并拥有夜视能力。
help.elf:
精灵比人类略高，但体型轻得多。他们缺乏其他种族的
力量和耐力，但更加敏捷。精灵是出色的法师和盗贼，
但作为战士或牧师只是一般。

精灵因其魔法本质而能有效抵抗魅惑法术。
然而，他们被铁器烧伜，因此不能使用铁或钢制品。
精灵很难被发现，因此精灵战士和盗贼自动获得
潜行和隐藏技能。他们拥有夜视能力。
help.giant:
巨人是最大的种族，身高9到12英尺。他们比任何其他
种族都强壮，几乎和矮人一样耐用。然而他们不太
聪明，巨大的体型使他们比其他种族更笨拙。
巨人制作了所有种族中最好的战士，但不适合其他职业。

巨人因其巨大体型而耐热和耐寒。然而，他们迟钝的
头脑使他们极易受到精神攻击。巨人和因体型和耐力，
免费获得快速治疗和撞击技能。

help.newbie:
啊！又一个寻求冒险的凡人。你应该先通过泥巴学校，
积累经验来面对外面的考验。一定要在公会房间练习武器，
否则你的停留将会非常短暂。输入 'equipment' 查看你的装备，
'spells' 查看你的法术，'skills' 查看你的技能，
'commands' 查看命令列表。大多数命令和能力都有帮助可用。

请输入 'help rules' 查看 ROM 的规则。
help.premise:
创建点数（CP）是你用来购买技能和技能组的货币。
你拥有的创建点数越多，升级所需的经验就越多。
技能组是相关技能的包——购买一个组，你就获得其中所有的技能。

每个技能组有一个创建点数成本。你可以使用 'add <组名>' 购买，
'drop <组名>' 丢弃，'info <组名>' 查看组内技能。

你最多可以拥有 300 创建点数。
help.group header:
以下技能和技能组可供你的角色选择：
（输入 list 可再次查看此列表）
help.group help:
以下命令可用：
list         显示所有尚未购买的技能组和技能
learned      显示所有已购买的技能组和技能
premise      创建点数和技能组的简要说明
add <名称>   购买一个技能或技能组
drop <名称>  丢弃一个技能或技能组
info <名称>  列出技能组包含的技能
help <名称>  技能、技能组或其他帮助主题的帮助
done         退出角色创建流程
help.menu choice:
选择（add/drop/list/help）？

ROM 技能系统允许你完全自定义新角色，
让他或她精通你选择的技能。但要注意，
你在角色创建时选择的技能是你永远不会
再学到的技能。技能用创建点数支付，
创建点数越多，升级越难。此外，高成本
的技能更难练习。

技能组是角色的包deal——购买一个组，
你就获得其中所有的技能。
help.areas:
语法：areas
语法：commands
语法：report
语法：score
语法：time
语法：weather

AREAS 显示游戏中所有区域的列表。

COMMANDS 显示游戏中所有命令。

REPORT 向你和房间内其他玩家显示你的当前状态。
SCORE 只显示给你自己，包含更详细的统计信息。
你的属性显示为 真实值(当前值)，例如
Str: 15(23) 表示你训练得到15点力量，但其他因素
（法术或物品）使当前力量为23。

TIME 显示游戏时间、MUD上次启动时间和本地时间。

WEATHER 显示当前游戏天气。
help.affects:
此命令用于显示影响你角色的所有法术。在低等级时
只显示法术名称，在高等级时还会显示法术效果和
持续时间。法术效果不再在score中显示（可以使用
'show'命令更改）。
help.alias:
语法：alias
      alias <word>
      alias <word> <substitution>
      unalias <word>

alias命令允许有限的命令缩写。目前别名不能调用
其他别名，也不能生成多个命令。

alias 单独使用列出当前所有别名
alias <word> 列出该别名（如果存在）
alias <word> <substitution> 创建新别名

你不能用别名替代alias或unalias。示例：

alias gc get all corpse --> 输入gc等于输入'get all corpse'
alias ff cast 'fireball' --> ff orc等于'cast 'fireball' orc'
help.compare:
语法：compare <object-1> <object-2>
语法：compare <object>

COMPARE 比较两件物品，告诉你哪件更好。
如果只指定一件物品，则与你当前装备的同类物品比较。
help.consider:
语法：consider <character>

CONSIDER 告诉你杀死某个角色的机会有多大。
这是一种估算对手强弱的好方法。
help.death:
当你角色死亡时，你会在神殿祭坛处重生。
你会损失一些经验值和金币（但不会损失等级）。

死亡时你会掉落所有装备（除非有loot保护）。
其他玩家可以拾取你的掉落物品。

如果你是被其他玩家杀死的（PK），惩罚会更轻。
help.description:
语法：description <string>
语法：description + <string>
语法：description

设置你的角色描述。其他玩家 look 你时会看到这段文字。
单独使用 description 显示当前描述。
使用 + 可以在描述末尾追加新行。
help.basics:
基础技能：

每个角色开始时有两个技能组，一个是种族的，
一个是职业的。你可以用创建点数购买更多技能组。

技能组是相关技能的集合——购买一个组就获得其中
所有技能。每个技能组有一个创建点数成本。

更多信息请查看 'help premise' 和 'help group header'。
help.cast:
语法：cast <spell> <target>

施放法术前你必须先练习过该法术。
每个法术有最低等级要求，并且需要足够的法力值。

某些法术需要目标（对自己或他人施放），
某些法术不需要目标。

使用 'practice' 查看你可以练习的法术。
使用 'spells' 查看你当前已学会的法术。
help.credits:
语法：credits

显示原始 DikuMUD 开发者名单。
help.colour:
语法：colour    切换颜色模式开/关

你也可以使用颜色代码在谈话中着色。
颜色代码格式：{x 其中x是颜色字母。

常见颜色：{r红 {g绿 {b蓝 {y黄 {w白 {c青 {m紫
help.recall:
语法：recall

RECALL 将你传送回神殿。需要吟唱一段时间。
RECALL 消耗你一半的移动点数。

RECALL 在某些地方不起作用。被诅咒的角色
无法使用RECALL。
help.practice:
语法：PRACTICE
语法：PRACTICE <skill|spell>

PRACTICE 不带参数显示你所有可用技能和法术的
当前熟练度。你可以在任何地方查看。

PRACTICE 带参数则练习该技能或法术。你的学习
百分比从0%（未学）到某个最大值（80%-100%之间，
取决于职业）。你必须在公会大师处练习。

智力越高，每次练习学到的越多。智慧越高，
每次升级获得的练习次数越多。未使用的练习
次数会累积。
help.train:
语法：train <str int wis dex con hp mana>

TRAIN 增加你的一项属性。游戏开始时你的角色
根据职业有标准属性和若干初始训练次数。
你可以在训练师处使用这些次数提升属性
（城镇中有几个训练师）。

一次训练可以提升一项属性，或增加10点hp/mana。
每升一级获得一次训练机会。

最值得优先训练的属性是WIS和CON。WIS给你更多
练习次数，CON给你更多生命值。长远来看，
先把WIS和CON都训练到18再练其他属性最划算。
help.follow:
语法：follow <character>
语法：group
语法：group <character>

FOLLOW 开始跟随另一个角色。要停止跟随，
只需 FOLLOW <你自己>。

GROUP <character> 使跟随你的角色成为你的组成员。
组成员共享杀怪经验，可以使用GTELL和SPLIT命令。
如果你的组成员被攻击，你会自动加入战斗。

如果该角色已经是你的组成员，GROUP会将其踢出。
角色也可以使用FOLLOW停止跟随来离开你的队伍。

GROUP 不带参数显示每个组成员的状态。

你只能FOLLOW和GROUP等级相差不超过5级的角色。
help.split:
语法：SPLIT <silver> <gold>

SPLIT 在你和同房间的所有组成员之间分配金币。
杀怪后惯例要SPLIT战利品。第一个参数是银币
数量（0可以接受），第二个是金币（可选）。
示例：
split 30    --> 分配30银币
split 20 50 --> 分配20银币、50金币
split  0 10 --> 分配10金币
help.rest:
语法：rest
语法：sleep
语法：stand
语法：wake

这些命令改变你的姿势。REST或SLEEP时，
你恢复生命、法力和移动点的速度更快。
但是你更容易受到攻击，SLEEP时
你不会听到很多发生的事情。

使用STAND或WAKE恢复到站立姿势。
你也可以WAKE其他沉睡的角色。
help.sacrifice:
语法：sacrifice <object>

SACRIFICE 将物品献给Mota，Mota可能会奖励你。
奖励的性质取决于物品的类型。
help.steal:
语法：STEAL coins <character>
语法：STEAL <object> <character>

STEAL 尝试从角色那里偷窃金币或物品。

对其他玩家使用STEAL会有惩罚。

要成功STEAL，你必须练习过相应的技能。
help.hide:
隐藏和潜行是相似的技能，都与保持不被发现有关。
Hide的成功率非常高，但只在角色保持静止时有效。
Sneak可以在移动时使用（包括潜行经过怪物），
但成功率较低。只有战士和盗贼可以学习这些技能。
help.backstab:
背刺是盗贼、刺客和其他流氓最喜欢的攻击方式。
可以使用任何武器类型，但穿刺武器最有效。
背刺造成的伤害取决于攻击者的等级、武器技能、
背刺技能和对手的实力。只有盗贼可以学习背刺。
help.bash:
撞击技能是战士的天赋，一种蛮力攻击，旨在将
敌人击倒在地。其成功取决于许多因素，包括
撞击等级、你的体重和对手的大小。
撞击龙通常不是明智的选择。
help.rescue:
患难见真情。在战斗中，拥有救援技能的战士
就是你需要的朋友。救援允许你在战斗中介入，
保护较弱的角色免受伤害。希望对方也会回报。
救援成功取决于技能等级，以及角色和目标之间
等级、敏捷和速度的比较。（注意：你救援的是
朋友，不是怪物）
help.heal:
语法：cast 'heal' <character>

治疗术是强大的治疗法术，可以恢复大量生命值。
这是牧师最重要的治疗法术之一。
help.cure light:
语法：cast 'cure light'    <character>
语法：cast 'cure serious'  <character>
语法：cast 'cure critical' <character>

这些治疗法术可以恢复目标的生命值。
轻微治疗恢复最少，严重治疗恢复较多，
致命治疗恢复最多。
help.create food:
语法：cast 'create food'

此法术创建一个魔法蘑菇，你或其他人都可以吃。
在冒险时确保有食物很重要。
help.create water:
语法：cast 'create water' <drink-container>

此法术补充饮水容器中的水。保持水分很重要。
help.sanctuary:
语法：cast 'sanctuary' <character>

庇护术保护目标免受伤害。处于庇护状态的角色
受到的伤害减半。这是一个强大的保护法术。
help.clan:
公会是一群玩家联合起来追求共同目标的组织。
公会成员可以互相交流、共享资源、一起冒险。

有关公会系统的更多信息，请咨询管理员。
help.afk:
输入AFK使你的角色进入保存消息模式：
任何对你的tell都会被保存，直到你关闭AFK模式。
这在离开键盘时很有用，这样你不会错过任何消息。
help.bug:
语法：bug <message>
语法：idea <message>
语法：typo <message>

这些命令用于向管理员报告错误、想法和拼写错误。
请使用这些命令帮助我们改进游戏！

3001.name: 莫塔神殿
3001.description: 你站在莫塔神殿大厅的南端。神殿由巨大的大理石块建造，外观永恒，大部分墙壁覆盖着古老的壁画，描绘着神祇、巨人和农民。巨大的台阶通向神殿大门，沿着神殿坐落的巨大山丘而下，通往下方的神殿广场。同样巨大的台阶向上延伸。

3002.name: 牧师内殿
3002.description: 这是内殿。墙上挂着强大的莫塔的画像，就在靠西墙的祭坛上方。地板中间的一口井通向黑暗的深处。

3003.name: 牧师酒吧
3003.description: 酒吧是这个国家最好的酒吧之一，幸运的是这是会员制。精美的家具摆放在房间四周。墙上挂着一个小小的标志。

3004.name: 牧师公会入口
3004.description: 入口大厅是一个小而朴素的房间，反映了牧师公会的真正本质——服务与奉献。出口通向东方通往神殿广场。北墙上有一个通往酒吧的小入口。

3005.name: 神殿广场
3005.description: 你站在神殿广场上。巨大的大理石台阶通向神殿大门。牧师公会入口在西边，古老的咕噜野猪旅馆在东边。南边通向主街。

3006.name: 咕噜野猪旅馆入口
3006.description: 你站在咕噜野猪旅馆的大厅里。大厅用简单但实用的家具精心装饰。小楼梯通向废弃的接待室，东边通向酒吧。

3007.name: 咕噜野猪旅馆
3007.description: 你站在酒吧里。酒吧靠北墙设置，古老的木制吧台上刻着文字、符号和标记。西墙里嵌着一个壁炉，东南方向通向旅馆。

3008.name: 废弃的接待处
3008.description: 你站在一个布满灰尘的废弃接待处。楼梯通向下方通往入口大厅。

3009.name: 面包店
3009.description: 你站在小面包店里。丹麦面包和优质面包的甜香弥漫在空气中。架子上整齐地摆放着面包，看起来是最高品质的。

3010.name: 杂货店
3010.description: 你在杂货店里。各种各样的物品堆放在柜台后面的架子上，安全地放在你够不到的地方。墙上挂着一张小纸条。

3011.name: 武器店
3011.description: 你在武器店里。柜台上有一张小纸条。

3012.name: 主街
3012.description: 你站在米德加德主街的尽头。南边是魔法用户公会的入口。街道向东延伸至市场广场。魔法商店在北边，西边通向市场。

3013.name: 主街
3013.description: 你走在穿过米德加德城的主街上。南边是盔甲店入口，北边是面包店。东边是市场广场。

3014.name: 市场广场
3014.description: 你站在市场广场上，著名的米德加德广场。广场中央矗立着一座巨大而奇特的雕像。道路通向四面八方，北通神殿广场。

3015.name: 主街
3015.description: 你走在穿过城镇的主街上。北边是杂货店，主街继续向东延伸。西边你能看到和听到市场，南边是珠宝店。

3016.name: 主街
3016.description: 主街，北边是武器店，南边是战士公会。东边离开城镇，西边街道通向市场广场。

3017.name: 法师公会入口
3017.description: 入口大厅是一个狭小、灯光昏暗的房间。

3018.name: 法师酒吧
3018.description: 酒吧是这个国家最奇怪的酒吧之一。神秘的图像在空中漂浮。精美家具的幻象出现在房间四周。

3019.name: 法师实验室
3019.description: 这是魔法实验实验室。黑暗的烟熏石头拱立在许多巨大的橡木桌上方，大部分桌上堆满了奇怪的管道和烧瓶。地板上覆盖着奇怪的物质。

3020.name: 盔甲店
3020.description: 盔甲店，墙上和橱窗里陈列着各种盔甲。你能看到头盔、盾牌和锁子甲。北边是主街。墙上有一张小纸条。

3021.name: 战士公会入口
3021.description: 战士公会入口大厅。一个必须小心说话（说错或说对）的地方。东边是酒吧，北边是主街。

3022.name: 战士酒吧
3022.description: 战士酒吧，曾经装饰得很漂亮。但现在家具都变成了碎片散落在你周围。南边是院子，西边是入口大厅。

3023.name: 比武训练场
3023.description: 战士的训练场。北边是酒吧。一口井通向黑暗深处。

3024.name: 穷巷东端
3024.description: 你在穷巷。南边是邋遢旅馆，东边是公共广场。忧郁的地图店在北边。巷子继续向西延伸。

3025.name: 公共广场
3025.description: 公共广场，人们从你身边经过，互相交谈。西边是穷巷，东边通向主街。

3026.name: 珠宝店
3026.description: 你站在珠宝店里。玻璃柜里展示着各种精美的珠宝和宝石。

3027.name: 主街
3027.description: 你走在主街上。北边是盗贼公会入口，南边是盔甲店。

3028.name: 盗贼公会入口
3028.description: 一个隐蔽的入口通向地下。楼梯向下通往盗贼公会。

3029.name: 盗贼酒吧
3029.description: 一个昏暗的地下酒吧。盗贼们在这里放松和分享消息。

3030.name: 盗贼藏身处
3030.description: 一个隐蔽的藏身处，盗贼们在这里密谋。

3031.name: 肮脏的巷子
3031.description: 一条肮脏的小巷，垃圾散落一地。

3032.name: 肮脏的巷子
3032.description: 一条肮脏的小巷，墙壁上满是污垢。

3033.name: 肮脏的巷子
3033.description: 一条肮脏的小巷，空气中弥漫着臭味。

3034.name: 肮脏的巷子
3034.description: 一条肮脏的小巷，老鼠在阴影中窜动。

3035.name: 肮脏的巷子
3035.description: 一条肮脏的小巷，地面湿滑。

3036.name: 肮脏的巷子
3036.description: 一条肮脏的小巷，破旧的建筑物矗立在两侧。

3111.description: 一条泥泞的巷子，你终于走出了这片迷宫。

3112.name: 公园小径
3112.description: 你站在公园的西入口。一条小径向东通往公园，向西通过入口你将到达公园路。

3113.name: 公园小径
3113.description: 你在公园里。小径通向北方和西方。西边是公园入口，东边你能看到一个小池塘。

3114.name: 池塘
3114.description: 你在池塘里游泳，感觉相当愚蠢。你可以从池塘的东西两端回到小径上。

3115.name: 公园小径
3115.description: 你在公园里。小径通向北方和东方。东边是公园入口，西边你能看到一个小池塘。

3116.name: 公园东入口
3116.description: 你站在公园的东端。一条小径向西通往公园。向东通过入口你将到达翡翠大道。

3117.name: 翡翠大道
3117.description: 你在翡翠大道上，道路继续向北和向南延伸。西边是公园入口，东边是米德加德不算大的市政厅。

3118.name: 公园路
3118.description: 你在公园路上，道路通向北方和南方。

3119.name: 翡翠大道
3119.description: 你站在翡翠大道的一个弯道处。道路通向北方和西方。东边，你看到一些破旧的贫民区……看起来像是城市的糟糕部分。

3120.name: 路口
3120.description: 你站在路口中央。道路通向四面八方。一根巨大的黑色铁链粗如树干，固定在路口中心的地面上。另一端消失在城墙之外。

3121.name: 翡翠大道
3121.description: 你站在翡翠大道的一个弯道处。道路通向南方和东方。

3122.name: 公园路
3122.description: 你在公园路上，道路通向南方和北方。榆树街在东边。

3123.name: 榆树街
3123.description: 你在榆树街上。公园路在西边，榆树街继续向东延伸。

3124.name: 榆树街
3124.description: 你接近榆树街的尽头。一棵老榆树长在这里。南边有一个沉重的铁栅栏，围绕着城市的墓地。你能看到格栅上挂着一个牌子。

3125.name: 翡翠大道
3125.description: 你在翡翠大道上，道路继续向北延伸。环城大道在南边。

3126.name: 公园路
3126.description: 你在公园路上，道路继续向北延伸。环城大道在南边。

3127.name: 环城大道
3127.description: 你站在城墙的西南角。环城大道向北和向东延伸。

3128.name: 环城大道
3128.description: 你走在风景优美的环城大道上，它继续环绕米德加德城。城市的南门在东边，城墙的西南角在西边。

3129.name: 环城大道
3129.description: 环城大道继续环绕城市。城市的南门在西边，公园路在北边。城墙的东北角在东边。

3130.name: 环城大道
3130.description: 你站在城墙的东南角。环城大道向北和向西延伸。

3131.name: 公园路
3131.description: 你在公园路上，道路继续向北和向南延伸。

3132.name: 翡翠大道
3132.description: 你站在翡翠大道的北端。北边是南方广场和凯特餐厅，东边是小街便士巷。

3133.name: 翡翠大道
3133.description: 你站在翡翠大道的一个弯道处。东边道路继续延伸，南边是路口。

3134.name: 翡翠大道
3134.description: 你站在翡翠大道的一个弯道处。西边道路继续延伸，北边是路口。

3135.name: 公园路
3135.description: 你在公园路的一个弯道处。北边道路继续延伸，东边是路口。南边，古老的悬崖从地下深处升起，形成一堵墙。

3136.name: 公园路
3136.description: 你在公园路的一个弯道处。南边道路继续延伸，西边是路口。

3137.name: 市政厅等候室
3137.description: 你站在市政厅的等候室里。木椅沿着墙壁排列，房间中央放着一张长桌子。

3138.name: 市长办公室
3138.description: 你在米德加德市长不算大的办公室里。一张大而光滑但完全空荡的桌子放在一把扶手椅前，那椅子看起来非常舒适，最像一张大床。

3139.name: 便士巷
3139.description: 你在便士巷上。翡翠大道在西边，便士巷继续向东延伸。

3140.name: 便士巷
3140.description: 你在便士巷上。狭窄的道路继续向北和向西延伸，环城大道在东边与这条街交汇。

3141.name: 便士巷尽头
3141.description: 你站在便士巷的尽头。唯一的出口似乎是南边。

3142.name: 卫队长办公室
3142.description: 你在卫队长办公室。米德加德市徽挂在北墙上，南边有一扇沉重的钢门。

3143.name: 监狱
3143.description: 你在一个黑暗潮湿的监狱里。黑暗的石墙坚硬而冰冷。北边有一扇沉重的钢门。

3144.name: 榆树街尽头
3144.description: 榆树街在这里结束，旁边是一个危险的破旧街区。你可以向东进入贫民区，或向南前往墓地。你注意到这不是城里最快乐的角落。

3150.name: 凯特餐厅
3150.description: 烤面包和炖菜的香味引导你跳舞般进入餐厅门口。这里没有油腻的勺子——卡座墙壁覆盖着休闲的佩斯利花纹；椅子很舒适。

3160.name: 忧郁的地图店
3160.description: 当你走进去时，一阵突如其来的风吹进商店，使几张纸片在房间里飞舞。你眨眼间被扬起的灰尘刺痛了眼睛，环顾这个商店。

3161.name: 忧郁的房间
3161.description: 当你进入这个房间时，淡淡的香味挑逗着你的鼻子。你踩上一块柔软的熊皮地毯，环顾四周。一张简单的床靠着远墙放置。

3170.name: 愚蠢神殿
3170.description: 当你进入废弃的仓库时，你的眼睛剧烈眨眼以适应几乎完全的黑暗。你想知道窗户在哪里，因为你踩进了地板中间的一个泥水坑。

3200.name: 桥下
3200.description: 桥拱被海藻覆盖，高出水面一英尺。河水温柔地流过城墙下部的开口。

3201.name: 河上
3201.description: 北边你看到穷巷的破旧建筑。河水流向西边的桥。河岸太陡无法攀爬。

3202.name: 河上
3202.description: 北边你看到垃圾场。河水从东向西流。河岸太陡无法攀爬。一座桥从头顶经过，连接垃圾场和步道。

3203.name: 河上
3203.description: 河堤直接在北边，凯特餐厅的小船码头在南边。河水东西方向流淌。

3204.name: 河上
3204.description: 你看到北岸的仓库。东边河水经过东桥穿过城墙。西边的河堤顺着水流方向。

3205.name: 河上
3205.description: 河水从东城墙的一个洞进入。洞口被几根垂直插入墙内的铁栅栏堵住了。头顶你能看到东桥的石墩。

3250.name: 城墙路
3250.description: 城墙路沿着城市的东墙向北和向南延伸。东大门在你北边，南边是与一条黑暗巷子的交叉口。你检查确保钱包还在。

3251.name: 城墙路
3251.description: 你沿着城市的东墙走在城墙路上，道路延伸于东大门和南边的桥之间。一条黑暗肮脏的巷子在西方。你小心翼翼地绕过一池水。

3252.name: 城墙路
3252.description: 米德加德的城墙在你东边高耸，保护城市免受敌人侵害……你希望如此。北边是与一条黑暗巷子的交叉口，南边是米德加德河上的桥。

3253.name: 桥上
3253.description: 你正在穿过一座坚固的石桥，桥跨越米德加德河。在你下方，河流流入城墙上的一个开口，用坚固的金属栅栏密封。北边是城墙路。

3254.name: 南桥
3254.description: 你站在一座小而摇晃的桥上，从米德加德城市垃圾场通往城市南部更吸引人的步道。你能闻到垃圾场的臭味。

3255.name: 米德加德南门内
3255.description: 两座坚固的石塔围绕着城墙中的一扇沉重木门，以防御潜伏在南方森林中的地精。如果你敢，你可以向南离开城市。

3256.name: 米德加德南门外
3256.description: 你站在米德加德南墙上坚固的木门外。守卫从大门两侧的塔楼上怀疑地注视着你，他们站岗保护城市。

3257.name: 城墙路
3257.description: 你走在城墙路上，就在米德加德西大门北边。道路沿着西墙继续向北，通往一个繁忙的氏族街交叉口。

3258.name: 城墙路
3258.description: 城墙路与拥挤的氏族路在此交汇，充满了商店和工匠。街道向东延伸，通往城市的远墙。城墙路继续向北和向南延伸。

3259.name: 城墙路
3259.description: 你走在城墙路上，它沿着米德加德西墙内侧延伸。南边，你能看到与拥挤的氏族街的交叉口。城墙的西北角在北边。

3260.name: 西北角
3260.description: 你站在城墙的西北角下方，在城墙路的一个转弯处。你可以向南前往西大门，或向东前往北大门。

3261.name: 城墙路
3261.description: 城墙在你上方高耸，当你走在城墙路上，在西边城墙的西北角和东边的米德加德北大门之间。

3262.name: 米德加德北门内
3262.description: 两座小塔围绕着坚固的木门，由一座设有谋杀孔的小石桥连接。这个大门不像其他大门那样守卫严密，因为外面的平原是安全的。

3263.name: 城墙路
3263.description: 你走在城墙路上，在北大门和城墙的东北角之间。你能看到路上的血迹……最好小心小偷。

3264.name: 东北角
3264.description: 城墙路在这里转弯，当你经过城墙的东北边缘。北大门在你西边，向南的道路通往米德加德的东大门。

3265.name: 城墙路
3265.description: 你北边是与拥挤的氏族街的交叉口。米德加德的东墙在你旁边，北边你能看到城墙的东北角。

3266.name: 城墙路
3266.description: 这里，城墙路与一条繁忙的氏族街交汇，通向西方和城市的远墙。你能闻到香料、香水、新鞣制的皮革和其他奇怪的气味。

3267.name: 城墙路
3267.description: 你在城墙路的中心，就在城市东大门北边。北边，你能看到与拥挤的氏族街的交叉口。大门的守卫怀疑地注视着你。

3268.name: 米德加德北门外
3268.description: 你站在有围墙的米德加德城北大门外。北边能看到一条尘土飞扬的小径，它环绕着城市的城墙。再往北是北方的广阔平原。

3270.name: 环城大道
3270.description: 米德加德坚固的石墙在西边耸立，阻挡邪恶。环城大道向北通往一座桥，并继续向南沿着一个美丽的公园延伸。

3271.name: 环城大道近公园
3271.description: 你走在环城大道上，沿着米德加德的西墙。北边，道路经过一个美丽的公园，南边，你能看到城墙的西南角。

3272.name: 环城大道经便士巷
3272.description: 你在一条环绕米德加德内墙的道路上。北边，环城大道通往一座桥进入米德加德北部。南边，你能看到与榆树街的交叉口。

3273.name: 环城大道经榆树街
3273.description: 当你经过榆树街墓地时，空气变得寒冷。米德加德的城墙在东边，环城大道继续向北和向南延伸。西边，你看到榆树街在墓地旁。

3301.name: 氏族路
3301.description: 你站在氏族路的西端。这里的交通很轻。这是米德加德一个较安静的区域。你能听到东边讨价还价的声音。

3302.name: 氏族路
3302.description: 你走在氏族路上。南边是货币兑换所。氏族路继续向东和向西延伸。

3303.name: 氏族路
3303.description: 这段氏族路上的商店早已关闭并用木板封住。没有太多交通经过这里，因为没有什么可买的。

3314.name: 氏族路
3314.description: 这段氏族路上充满了噪音和灯光。氏族路继续向东和向西延伸。

3315.name: 氏族路
3315.description: 氏族路在这里似乎稍微变宽了，允许更多交通通过。南边是繁忙酒吧的另一个入口。这扇门也敞开着，传出声音。

3316.name: 氏族路
3316.description: 你站在氏族路的东端。东边，城市周围的高墙在你面前耸立，投下阴影。氏族路继续向西延伸。

3334.name: 货币兑换所
3334.description: 几盏 strategically 放置的灯笼在没有窗户的情况下保持这里明亮。房间装饰得出奇地好，墙上挂着挂毯。你会用你的生命打赌这里很安全。

3352.name: 灰雁酒馆
3352.description: 潜水。这是你所能说的关于这个地方的全部；它就是个潜水处。你小心翼翼地跨过地板上死去和/或喝醉的水手，走向房间中央。

3355.name: 安迪酒吧
3355.description: 繁忙的酒吧充满了顾客。人们在笑和唱歌。一位吟游诗人在酒吧的另一部分弹奏着他的鲁特琴，几个人甚至在跳舞。

3356.name: 酒吧房间
3356.description: 酒吧的这部分充满了舞蹈和歌声。一位流浪的吟游诗人坐在角落的椅子上弹着鲁特琴。一位红发女子站在他旁边唱着喜剧英雄的故事。

3357.name: 酒吧柜台
3357.description: 一张长长的桃花心木酒吧设置在酒吧的后部。杯子排在酒吧后面的架子上。强烈而难看的液体瓶子装饰着下面的架子之一。

3358.name: 酒吧柜台
3358.description: 一张长长的桃花心木酒吧设置在酒吧的后部。杯子排在酒吧后面的架子上。强烈而难看的液体瓶子装饰着下面的架子之一。

3359.name: 安迪旅馆
3359.description: 你站在安迪酒吧楼上的安迪旅馆。几把椅子和几个茶几给房间一种家的氛围。一个大石壁炉在一面墙上明亮地燃烧，温暖着房间。

3700.name: MUD学校入口
3700.description:
这里是Merc MUD学校的入口。向北进入MUD学校。如果你以前来过这里想直接去竞技场，向南走。

一个牌子警告：'一旦你超过5级，就不能再通过这扇门了。'

3701.name: MUD学校的一个房间
3701.description: 你在一个方形的白色房间里。墙壁都是空白的，没有窗户。柔和的白光从天花板反射下来。当然，墙上有个牌子。出口是西和南。

3702.name: 中心房间
3702.description: 你在一个方形的白色房间里。墙壁都是空白的，没有窗户。柔和的白光从天花板反射下来。当然，墙上有个牌子。出口通向四面八方。

3710.description:
你在一个臭气熏天的笼子里。奇怪的是，墙壁仍然很干净！
你看到墙上有个牌子。唯一的出口是向上。

3711.description: 你在一个方形的白色房间里。墙壁都是空白的，没有窗户。柔和的白光从天花板反射下来。当然，墙上有个牌子。

3712.description: 你在笼子房间里。四周有4个笼子。柔和的白光从天花板反射下来。当然，墙上有一个大牌子。出口通向四个基本方向以及下方。

3713.name: 笼子
3713.description: 你在一个笼子里。到处都是血迹。看守们一定疏于管理了！墙上有个牌子。唯一的出口是南。

3718.name: MUD学校商店
3718.description: 你在一个拥挤的房间里。整齐地堆放在各处架子上的是一些物品和包裹。柔和的白光从天花板反射下来。当然，墙上有个牌子。唯一的出口是东。

3720.name: 黑暗的房间
3720.description: 这个房间被特意弄暗了，这样你需要拿着光源才能通过。墙壁当然是空白的、白色的。唯一的出口是南。

3721.name: MUD学校尽头！
3721.description: 这是一个非常明亮的房间，中央有一个大理石基座。基座后面站着一个披着银色斗篷的人。每面墙上都挂着挂毯，你感到非常快乐。

3722.name: 竞技场南墙
3722.description: 你在竞技场中。记住，如果你想离开这个竞技场，只需向上走。在这个巨大的竞技场中几乎看不到天花板。你感觉好像有某个神圣的存在在注视着你。

3749.description: 你靠在地牢的一面墙上。这里相当暗。没有窗户解释了周围的异味。

3757.name: MUD学校的一个房间
3757.description: 你在MUD学校的一个房间里。墙上挂着MUD学校英雄毕业生的画像。西边是弗雷的训练室，东边是祖姆的公会房间。北边是下一个训练阶段。

3758.name: 弗雷的训练室
3758.description: 你在弗雷的训练室里。周围是各种体能和智力训练工具。整个房间充满了魔法、神圣和汗水。墙上有个牌子。

3759.name: 祖姆的公会房间
3759.description: 你在一个堆满武器、书籍和许多战斗假人的房间里，有些被砍刺了很多次，有些被烧焦了。房间里充满了汗水和魔法的气息。墙上有个牌子。

3760.name: 安全房间
3760.description: 你在一个安全的房间里，远离竞技场中那些凶恶的兔子和蜗牛。你可以在这里休息，向上走可以回到莫塔神殿。

7001.name: 泥泞的下水道
7001.description:
你站在泥中 没到膝盖. This is not the kind of place
for a picnic. 泥泞的下水道 继续延伸到 the south.

7002.name: 泥泞的下水道 junction
7002.description:
泥泞的下水道 向黑暗中延伸 向南. It looks as if 
no person has ever sat his foot here before. It's too muddy for that
anyway. The sewer 通向北方, south and east from here.

7003.name: 泥潭
7003.description:
你站在泥中 all the way up 没到大腿 and it's not too 
comfortable since you are used to a somewhat different environment.
The sewer leads 向北 of here. In the middle you can just make
out an enormous 排水管 leading down.

7004.name: The Dark Pit
7004.description:
You are standing by the edge of a dark pit that 通向下 into even
deeper 黑暗. >BWWAAADDRR< - 气味 from down there is 无法忍受的.
The sewer 向黑暗中延伸ness 向东.

7005.name: 泥泞的下水道
7005.description:
You are standing in the middle of a bend of 下水道 pipe. It is very
dark around here and the mud is sticking to your legs, not very pleasant.
The pipe 通向东方 and south from here.

7006.name: 泥泞的下水道
7006.description:
You are standing in something that reminds you very much of porridge, this
has the advantage that it's not hot, it's rather cold actually. The pipe 
bends 向北 and east.

7007.name: 泥泞的下水道 bend
7007.description:
This isn't your idea of a place to stay too long. You're in up to your
knees in something that resembles mud, but you're not quite sure. The
bend in which you stand 通向西方 and south.

7008.name: A muddy intersection
7008.description:
You have both your feet safely stuck in mud. It isn't the mud that's wrong
it's 气味, the sounds, the total 黑暗 that surrounds you. Everything
here is so depressing. The pipe leads on with a trail of thick mud to the
north, east and south.

7009.name: The Sewer Junction
7009.description:
你站在 in the middle of a huge junction of sewer pipes right under
what you'd think was an air shaft. The sewer pipes lead 向北,
south, east and west. It look quite impossible to force your way up.

7010.name: A bend in sewer pipe
7010.description:
你在 a bend in 下水道 pipe. A strong 气味 seeps in from the north.
The sewer goes north and east.

7011.name: 泥泞的下水道 pipe
7011.description:
You have entered a kind of tube intersection that 通向南方, west and east.
Your legs are covered in mud up to the knees. REAL yucky!

7012.name: The bend in the Muddy sewer
7012.description:
This is not your idea of a holiday. 你站在泥中 up 没到膝盖.
It's absolutely inconceivable how all this mud could have been placed
here. The pipe leads 向西 and south.

7013.name: A MUDDY intersection
7013.description:
You wouldn't want to know the true feeling of standing in this mud up to 
your hips. >BWAADR<. All that fills your mind right now is the dream of 
a hot bath. This is NOT very clean mud you know, remember you're in the
sewer! The pipes 通向北方, south and east.

7014.name: Muddy sewer
7014.description:
你站在 in a bend of the pipe system of 下水道 with mud up to your
thighs. Contemplating a higher level of existence here would be utterly
inappropriate, as 气味 would keep any intelligent creature from even
thinking of anything but getting away from this foul end of the WORLD.
The bend goes from north to west.

7015.name: The old well
7015.description:
You are standing by an old and worn well from before this century. The sewer
leads 向东 from here and the well 通向下 into 黑暗. Metal
bars implanted in the side of the well lead down as a ladder.

7016.name: The ordinary bend
7016.description:
你在 the middle of a bend in the pipe system of 下水道 system, 
WHAT a place!!! The pipe leads 向南 and the east.

7017.name: 下水道 junction
7017.description: 你在 a junction that 通向北方, west and south.

7018.name: The ordinary junction
7018.description:
This looks like an ordinary junction, actually it seems very quiet
here. The pipelines lead west, east and north.

7021.name: A quiet pipe junction
7021.description:
This is the kind of place to rest, though 气味 could be a LOT better
than this. The sewer goes east, north and west from here.

7022.name: The odd room with smooth walls
7022.description:
As you enter you hear a loud click from one of the walls ... and you fall
and fall and fall ...
.
.
.
.
 ... And come to an abrupt end. THIS is strange indeed. There's an arched
entryway leading down.

7024.name: 下水道
7024.description:
你站在泥中 up to your ankles. This is an intersection with 
sewer pipes leading east, south and west.

7025.name: Another intersection
7025.description:
You have never seen anything so BORING...This is an intersection with pipes
leading north, south and east.

7026.name: A junction
7026.description:
This one seems interesting, a big difference from all the other junctions.
It seems cleaner than the rest of them. Weird. Something that looks like 
an air shaft 通向上wards, but it looks far too slippery to climb.
The pipes lead 向南, west and north.

7028.name: 下水道 junction
7028.description: 你站在 in a junction of sewer pipes leading north, east and west.

7029.name: The Triple Junction
7029.description:
你站在 in the middle of a huge junction of concrete sewer pipes. The 
pipes lead into three different directions : east, south and west.

7030.name: The Quadruple Junction Under the Dump
7030.description:
You are standing in something that reminds you of an entry to an ant hive.
There are enormous concrete pipes leading north, south, east and west. 
There's also a metal ladder built into the concrete wall leading up through
a layer of garbage.

7031.name: A triple junction
7031.description: 你站在 in a junction with pipes leading west, north and east.

7034.name: A bend in the sewer pipe
7034.description: You can look in two directions where the pipe leads : south and west.

7035.name: 下水道 pipe bend
7035.description:
You can look in two different directions where the pipe goes : west and 
north.

7036.name: The pit
7036.description:
你站在 in a section of a pipe that leads to a dead end. In the floor
there's a pit leading down. There are bars set in the side of the pit wall
functioning as a ladder.

7037.name: The round room
7037.description:
As you enter 房间 it starts rotating - at first slowly, later faster
and faster - You get totally confused as to where up and down are, but you are
certain that the doorway is in the opposite direction of what it was when
you entered. It now 通向东方. There was only this one exit.

7038.name: The three way junction
7038.description: You are standing in a junction of pipes that lead west, east and south.

7039.name: The Sewer Store Room
7039.description:
你站在 in a small room lit by a single torch set in the wall. The only 
way out of here is 向北.

7041.name: The Shaft
7041.description:
You are standing by the edge of a deep, dark shaft leading down. A single
ladder is your tool to work your way down if you so wish. The sewer pipe
通向南方 from here.

7043.name: The Sewer Entrance
7043.description:
你站在 in the middle of a pipe that leads from north to south. Above you
an air shaft 通向上 into sunlight. It seems totally impossible to go up
that way.

7044.name: The junction going three ways
7044.description:
你在 a 通道way in the pipes of 下水道 system leading north, east
and west.

7045.name: The Sewer Room
7045.description:
You are standing in a large room with chairs set in the walls. You have the
feeling of being watched. To the south there's an entry to a larger room.
房间 is lit by five torches, also set in the walls. To the west there
is a doorway leading out to 下水道s.

7046.name: The Sewer room
7046.description:
This is a Room with walls that glitters like gold though not quite like it.
This is strange as it looks as if the glitter lights the whole room. It
looks very bright. To the south the floor is covered with yucky water. The
North leads to sort of a Guard Room.

7047.name: The Pool in the Sewer
7047.description:
你站在 in water to your waist.  To the north is the entrance to this room.
A single door 通向东方.

7048.name: The Sewers
7048.description:
你站在 in a dead end of 下水道. The only way out is south.
你能看到 a shaft leading up but it looks too difficult to go up
that way.

7049.name: The junction
7049.description: 你站在 in a junction leading north, west and east.

7050.name: The small room
7050.description:
The only thing in this room of interest is a chair, and that's tight to the 
rock floor. A doorway 通向南方 and another 通向东方 into 黑暗.

7051.name: The Sewer pipe
7051.description:
你在 what reminds you of a foul sewer, as if you liked being here! 
你能看到 two 出口 leading either north or south.

7052.name: The Grand Sewer
7052.description:
你在 a Grand Sewer Pipe. This stretches toward the south. It's large 
indeed! A doorway leads 向东 from here.

7053.name: The South end of the Grand Pipe
7053.description:
你站在 in water 没到膝盖. A doorway 通向西方 from here. The Pipe
stretches north.

7055.name: The Edge of The Water Sewer
7055.description:
你站在 in a room where half of the floor is covered in water. The water
通向东方 and a doorway 通向西方.

7056.name: The Dark hallway
7056.description:
You can't see much of this, even with a light. The hallway goes into a
通道way 向南. A doorway 通向西方.

7057.name: 黑暗 passageway
7057.description:
You can't see anything but the ground where you put your feet. The 
通道way seems to continue south and north.

7058.name: 黑暗 passageway
7058.description:
You can't see anything but the ground where you put your feet. The
通道way seems to continue south and north.

7059.name: 黑暗 passageway
7059.description:
You can't see anything but the ground where you put your feet. The
通道way seems to continue south and north.

7060.name: 黑暗 passageway
7060.description:
You can't see anything but the ground where you put your feet. The
通道way seems to continue west and north. To the east there's water
covering the floor and that leads through an arched entry to a watery
sewer.

7061.name: The Watery Sewer Bend
7061.description:
You can't see anything but 水 you're in up to your hips. The sewer
seems to bend and lead south and west.

7062.name: The Watery sewer
7062.description:
You can't see anything but 水 you're in up to your hips. The sewer
seems to lead south and north.

7063.name: The Watery sewer
7063.description:
You can't see anything but 水 you're in up to your hips. The sewer
seems to lead south and north.

7064.name: The Watery Sewer Junction
7064.description:
You can't see anything but 水 you're in up to your hips. The sewer
seems to lead into a junction going south, north and east.

7065.name: The Watery sewer
7065.description:
You can't see anything but 水 you're in up to your hips. The sewer
seems to lead south and north.

7066.name: The Watery 下水道交汇口
7066.description:
You can't see anything but 水 you're in up to your hips. The sewer
seems to lead into a junction that goes north, south and east.

7067.name: The Watery sewer
7067.description:
You can't see anything but 水 you're in up to your hips. The sewer
seems to lead south and north.

7068.name: The Watery sewer bend
7068.description:
You can't see anything but 水 you're in up to your hips. The sewer
seems to bend and lead west and north.

7069.name: A ledge by the dark pool
7069.description:
You can't see much here but the echo tells you that there's quite a drop
down. You can just make out a huge dark pool out there in 黑暗, 
mostly because of the trickling of water. The water from 下水道 actually
washes over this ledge and makes it quite slippery. From here it drops, 
like a waterfall, into the pool far down.

7070.name: A ledge by the dark pool
7070.description:
You can't see much here but the echo tells you that there's quite a drop
down. You can just make out a huge dark pool out there in 黑暗,
mostly because of the trickling of water. The water from 下水道 actually
washes over this ledge and makes it quite slippery. From here it drops,
like a waterfall, into the pool far down. Under you there is a small fissure
in the rock. It seems big enough to contain a few people.

7099.name: The fissure under the ledge
7099.description:
This is a small fissure in the solid rock. Under you lies the deep dark pool.
The water trickles quietly down from the ledge above you. The water 气味s 
like 水 in a sewer.

7101.name: Under the mudhole
7101.description:
你站在 in a small room with a great big opening in the ceiling. From this
opening there's mud dripping down in large lumps. >YUCK<. You can 气味 the 
foul 恶臭 of the slimy sediment as you try not to get covered by the 
falling sludge. To the east there is an entryway leading out from here and 
it seems absolutely impossible to force the muddy descent.

7102.name: Under the Dark Pit
7102.description:
Nice place you found yourself. 你站在 in the middle of a room with only
two 出口, Up and East. A tall ladder is left here so that you can climb
up through the Pit without the use of a rope.

7103.name: A muddy bend in the sewer system
7103.description:
You are standing in what looks like a bend in the pipe system of the
sewer. The 'floor' is covered completely by mud! This includes covering
your legs up 没到膝盖 as well. The pipe 通向西方 and south.

7104.name: A junction in the sewer pipes
7104.description:
你站在 in the middle of what looks like a triple junction of pipes
going east, west and north.

7105.name: Down the old well
7105.description:
You are dangling on the slippery sides of the old well leading down and up.
The only secure point here is the metal bars that are cemented into the 
sides, the ones that you cling frantically to so that you don't fall. Who
knows how deep this well is?

7106.name: The northwestern corner of the ledge
7106.description:
你站在, swaying out from the ledge, with only a couple of inches of safe, 
solid ledge under your feet. The ledge continues 向东 but not back
south. It seems that the ledge is too narrow to turn on so you'll have to
continue forward.

7107.name: The narrow ledge
7107.description:
你在 the progress of walking all the way around the ledge since there's
no way of turning around on this all too narrow path. There IS another exit
from here but that leads right into mid-air and with high probability of a
free fall session afterwards.

7108.name: The narrow ledge
7108.description:
你在 the progress of walking all the way around the ledge since there's
no way of turning around on this all too narrow path. There IS another exit
from here but that leads right into mid-air and with high probability of a
free fall session afterwards.

7109.name: The narrow ledge
7109.description:
你在 the progress of walking all the way around the ledge since there's
no way of turning around on this all too narrow path. There IS another exit
from here but that leads right into mid-air and with high probability of a
free fall session afterwards.

7110.name: The narrow ledge
7110.description:
你在 the progress of walking all the way around the ledge since there's
no way of turning around on this all too narrow path. There IS another exit
from here but that leads right into mid-air and with high probability of a
free fall session afterwards.

7111.name: The southwestern corner of the ledge
7111.description:
This seems like a ledge that is a little broader than the one just to the 
north of here. The ledge seems to lead around some sort of Abyss of total 
黑暗. The ledge seems to have an odd-looking edge here.

7112.name: An odd intersection
7112.description:
你站在 in a rather odd intersection of pipes. The pipes actually don't
resemble pipes anymore. They look more like a real stone tunnel, or a
通道way hewn directly into the rock. The ways from here lead north, east
and west.

7113.name: The narrow ledge going east to west
7113.description:
你在 the process of walking all the way around the ledge since there's
no way of turning around on this all too narrow path. There IS another exit
from here but that leads right into mid-air and with high probability of a
free fall session afterwards.

7114.name: Mid-air
7114.description:
You've just stepped into the most unlucky position in the whole of Merc Mud.
The result of such a foolish act should be punished with death, you know.
With an acceleration of approximately 9.82 metres per second per second, you
are now descending the Abyss. What awaits you at the bottom will continue to
be a mystery. Bye Cruel World.

You've fallen, and you can't get up!!!

7115.name: The Broad ledge
7115.description:
You are standing on a ledge that seems quite a lot larger than the rest 
of the ledges. This one leads 向西 and the east, plus it has an exit
going 向南. Though you could jump into mid-air, but it probably 
wouldn't be such a good idea. The way south is in utter 黑暗.

7116.name: The northeastern corner of the ledge
7116.description:
你站在, swaying out from the ledge, with only a couple of inches of safe,
solid ledge under your feet. The ledge continues 向西 and 通向南方
from here into 黑暗.

7117.name: The narrow eastern ledge
7117.description:
你在 the progress of walking all the way around the ledge since there's
no way of turning around on this all too narrow path. There IS another exit
from here but that leads right into mid-air and with high probability of a
free fall session afterwards. And THAT is west of here so watch your step.

7118.name: The narrow eastern ledge
7118.description:
你在 the progress of walking all the way around the ledge since there's
no way of turning around on this all too narrow path. There IS another exit
from here but that leads right into mid-air and with high probability of a
free fall session afterwards. And THAT is west of here so watch your step.

7119.name: The narrow eastern ledge
7119.description:
你在 the progress of walking all the way around the ledge since there's
no way of turning around on this all too narrow path. There IS another exit
from here but that leads right into mid-air and with high probability of a
free fall session afterwards. And THAT is west of here so watch your step.

7120.name: The narrow eastern ledge
7120.description:
你在 the progress of walking all the way around the ledge since there's
no way of turning around on this all too narrow path. There IS another exit
from here but that leads right into mid-air and with high probability of a
free fall session afterwards. And THAT is west of here so watch your step.
You also see a small opening 向东.

7121.name: The southeastern corner of the ledge
7121.description:
This seems like a ledge that is a little broader than the one just to the
north of here. The ledge seems to lead around some sort of abyss of total
黑暗.

7122.name: Under the pit
7122.description: 你站在 in a completely dark cavern leading west. The wall looks weird here.

7123.name: Under The Shaft
7123.description:
A ladder 通向上 from here to the Shaft.
一个小的 opening 通向西方 from here.

7129.name: 下水道 line.
7129.description:
你在 a narrow part of 下水道. Down 下水道 continues and to the
north is the ledge.

7130.name: 下水道 pipe.
7130.description:
你在 an odd sewer pipe You see some odd scratches on the pipe wall, as
from a gigantic rat. 你能看到 some slimy water gently running down into
a sewer drain, and north the drain continues.

7190.name: Mid-air
7190.description:
You've just stepped into the most unlucky position in the whole of DikuMUD.
The result of such a foolish act should be punished with death, you know.
With an acceleration of approximately 9.82 metres per second per second, you
are now descending the Abyss. What awaits you at the bottom will continue to
be a mystery. Bye Cruel World.

You've fallen, and you can't get up!!!

7199.name: The Edge of the Water
7199.description:
The pool side is dimly lit up by your light. 你能看到 absolutely nothing
else nearby. The 黑暗 here seems enormously oppressive. The air is
damp and the rock on which you stand is slippery. The pool seems too dark 
to make anything clear. The rock can be climbed upwards from here.

7200.name: The Treasury
7200.description:
你在 a small but well equipped treasury.  你能看到 some writing on
the wall.  The ceiling has a funny glow, which enables you to see.  You can
get back into the inner lair through the stone door which is east.

7201.name: The inner Lair
7201.description:
你在 a octagonal room with smooth purple stone walls.  The floor is 
made from black stone.  In the western wall you see a large black stone door.

7202.name: The Lair
7202.description:
On the floor you see a lot of human decay, like bones and skulls. You also
see a lot of slime. On the wall is a torch sitting in its sconce. To the north 
are a wooden door.

7203.name: The Lair
7203.description:
On the floor you see a lot of human decay, like bones and skulls. You also
see a lot of slime. On the wall is a torch sitting in its sconce.

7204.name: The Lair
7204.description:
On the floor you see a lot of human decay, like bones and skulls. You also
see a lot of slime. On the wall is a torch sitting in its sconce.

7205.name: The Lair
7205.description:
On the floor you see a lot of human decay, like bones and skulls. You also
see a lot of slime. On the wall is a torch sitting in its sconce.

7206.name: The lair.
7206.description:
On the floor you see a lot of human decay, like bones and skulls. You also
see a lot of slime. On the wall is a torch sitting in its sconce.

7207.name: The lair.
7207.description:
On the floor you see a lot of human decay, like bones and skulls. You also
see a lot of slime. On the wall is a torch sitting in its sconce.

7208.name: The lair entrance.
7208.description:
你在 a dry part of 下水道. To the north is a wooden door, you 
can see some slime at the lower part of the door. You also see some skulls
and some broken bones.

7209.name: The crawlway.
7209.description: 你在 a narrow crawlway.  You don't notice anything interesting here.

7210.name: The four-way junction.
7210.description:
你在 a 下水道交汇口. To the north is a small hole, 向西 is a
narrow crawlway and 向东 and south 下水道 continues.

7211.name: The small cave.
7211.description: 你在 a collapsed sewer drain, which now is more like a small cave.

7212.name: 下水道 drain.
7212.description: 你在 a dry sewer drain which bends 向北.

7213.name: 下水道 drain.
7213.description: 你在 a dry sewer drain which bends 向东.

7214.name: 排水口 end.
7214.description:
You are at the end of the drain around you 下水道 has collapsed, the only
exit is west.

7215.name: The half-wet drain.
7215.description:
你在 a sewer drain where the floor is covered with water. To the north
it looks more dry, south however the drain runs down into some water.

7216.name: Under water in the sewer.
7216.description:
You swim in some dirty water and is holding you breath. You'll better 
continue before you drown. It is a good thing that you can hold your light
above water-level.

7217.name: The half-dry drain.
7217.description:
你在 a half-dry sewer drain. To the north the drain runs a little bit
downwards into some water 向东 你能看到 a small hole. To the west
you see another drain.

7218.name: The very small room.
7218.description: 你在 a very small room, it is pretty uninteresting.

7219.name: A dry sewer drain.
7219.description: 你在 a dry but dirty sewer drain. The drain continues east and south.

7220.name: A boring drain.
7220.description: 你在 yet another sewer drain.

7221.name: 下水道 drain.
7221.description:
你在 a sewer drain, there is nothing special in here, except for a 
loud echo.

7222.name: 下水道 drain.
7222.description: 你在 a drain, with some slimy water on the floor.

7223.name: 下水道 bend.
7223.description: You find yourself in an ordinary sewer bend, which bend from west to north.

7224.name: 下水道 junction
7224.description:
你站在 in a junction of three sewer drains. You see some odd scratches on
the pipe wall, as from a gigantic rat.North and south 下水道 continues 
as usual, but west it looks a little strange.

7225.name: 下水道
7225.description:
你在 a sewer, where the slimy water runs down through a tiny hole.
You see some odd scratches on the pipe wall, as from a gigantic rat. There 
is a sewer drain south.

7229.name: The strange sewer
7229.description:
你在 a very strange sewer indeed, there are some odd scratches on the
pipe wall, as from a gigantic rat. And 你能看到 a lot of organic decay
like bones from animals AND humans. West the drain runs slightly upwards.

7230.name: The damp sewer
7230.description:
你在 a sewer drain with a funny damp substance on the floor, in the 
substance you see a lot of decay. You see some odd scratches on the wall, as
from a gigantic rat. Both 向东 and west the pipe seems to run down.

7231.name: The strange sewer
7231.description:
你在 an ordinary sewer except for a lot of scratches on 下水道 wall,
ad a lot of debris on the floor.

7232.name: 下水道
7232.description:
你在 a sewer with more scratches on the walls. And of course a whole lot
of decay. The drain runs east and north.

7233.name: 下水道 drain
7233.description:
你站在 in in a sewer drain, you are able to see some kind of cave-like
room. You see some odd scratches on the drain wall, as from a gigantic rat. 
The sewer 通向南方.

7234.name: The rat's lair
7234.description:
你在 a little cave. You are able to see quite a lot of debris on the 
floor. There is a sewer drain west of here.

7279.name: The Wall of the Abyss
7279.description:
You hang onto some steps leading down into utter 黑暗. There's an exit 
leading up as well, though you'll have to open the tiny rock again to do so.

7280.name: The entrance.
7280.description:
你在 a very dark room. You notice that some faces are
staring at you from inside the walls. In the middle of 房间
there is a small altar. To the north there is a small round
door.

7281.name: 走廊.
7281.description:
The 走廊 is glowing oppressively in a red hue. You can hear wailing
through an open black hole 向东. To the south there is a round door.

7282.name: The Realm of lost souls
7282.description:
You are standing in nothing. All around you there are stars.
Sometimes a shadow flies closely by you, wailing very loudly. 
To the north there is a small bright hole. To the west there is 
a small red hole.

7283.name: The T-crossing
7283.description:
你在 a small hallway. There are doors 向东 and to
the west. To the south there are a black hole. There is writing
in the wall. Wails can be heard from the south.

7284.name: The firedeath
7284.description:
This room is very hot. There are flames surrounding you.  You can
see no 出口 at all!  Skeletons are lying all over the floor.

7285.name: The tortureroom.
7285.description:
You are standing in a middle of a square room. Along the walls skeletons 
are hanging in rusty chains. In the middle of 房间 there is a big metal 
box, covered with dust. To the south you can just make out a small exit.

7286.name: The hells yard
7286.description:
You are standing in a lot of mud. A disgusting 气味 surrounds
the place, and makes you feel sick. Small flames sometimes shoot
up from the hot mud. To the west there is a small door. To the 
north 你能看到 an iron door.

7301.name: The Entrance to the Realm of silence
7301.description:
This is an utterly silent place. As you look around you see that there
hasn't been a living thing in a long time. The dust lies here in a thick
layer on the floor and on the furniture. On the wall hangs a bleak and 
worn tapestry. A winding stone staircase 通向上 into 黑暗. On the 
wall 向西 你能看到 a huge torch stuck into the solid rock.
一个大的 portcullis blocks your way 向北.

7399.name: On the walls of the Abyss
7399.description:
You are clutching the steps on the wall so that you don't fall to the ground
down below.
一个大的 sign says : I haven't gotten any further ... Yet. But  I'm pushing
                    to get finished with this sewer. 
                                           Greetings and Good Health :)

                                                     Redferne The Gentle
This stops your journey down, the only exit is up.

7400.name: Cave entrance
7400.description:
You are standing in the cave entrance. It is very dark
down here. There is writing at the wall. There is an exit
向北. A stairway 通向上.

7401.name: Cave tunnel
7401.description:
You are walking in a tunnel. It is very cold. You
can feel the presence of a living thing ... SOMEWHERE.

7402.name: Cave room
7402.description:
You are standing in a room. It's much cooler now.
The walls are glowing.

7403.name: Cave T-cross
7403.description:
You are standing in a mud-like substance. 气味 here is
糟糕的, it is rotten. To the west 你能看到 some light.

7404.name: Cave turning-point
7404.description:
The mud are getting deeper. You are wondering, 'Would
it be an idea to leave, before I disappear?'. To the
south you notice a flat round stone are blocking the
way. To the west 你能看到 mud.

7405.name: The secret room
7405.description:
There is dust all over the place. It looks like nobody
has been here for ages. In the middle of 房间 you see
a socket with a crystal globe. The globe glows with a
pulsing light. To the north you see a stone door. To the
south you see a grey block.

7406.name: 泥潭
7406.description:
You are standing in a lot of mud. The mud goes to your
chest. You feel the presence of something IN the mud.
The only obvious exit is 向西.

7407.name: Tunnel
7407.description:
The mud goes 没到膝盖. Otherwise 隧道 looks
very normal.

7408.name: The long tunnel
7408.description:
Here There is almost no mud, as you stand at the top
of a small rock. Just beside you there are a sign which
says 'WARNING! The worms are dangerous!'.

7409.name: The hot room
7409.description:
You are very surprised, as this room for a change are
hot instead of cold. To the north it goes downwards into
some mud. There are also an exit 向西.

7410.name: The small room
7410.description:
As you look around you notice a small statue. There are
出口 向西 and 向东.

7411.name: The stalagmite cave
7411.description:
You are standing in a stalagmite cave. Water is dripping
from the walls. It is very cold in here.

7412.name: The stalagmite tunnel
7412.description:
You have entered a small tunnel. Here it is quite dry.
Maybe it would be an idea to rest here.

7413.name: The spongy room
7413.description:
You definitely NOT like this area. It is very dank, and most
of the places it is wet.

7414.name: The stalagmite T-cross
7414.description:
You are standing in a cross. To the north 你能看到
some light. Otherwise it is dark.

7415.name: The blind end room
7415.description:
This room is obviously a blind end. To the north you see
a primitive picture.

7416.name: The treasure room
7416.description:
This room is rich ornamented. The walls has carves showing
persons dancing around a sun which is drawn at the floor. It
looks very old, and it is very dusty. To the south you see a
secret door.

7417.name: The square lair
7417.description:
You are standing in the south-east part of the lair. You can
see a skeleton lying at the wall.

7418.name: The square lair
7418.description:
You are standing in the north-east part of the lair. You see
a sign at the wall

7419.name: The square lair
7419.description:
You are standing in the north-west part of the lair. Here's
another sign. There are a exit from the lair 向北.

7420.name: The lair end
7420.description:
你能看到 a table in front of you. It's very dusty.
Around the table five skeletons are siting. Exits are
north and east.

7421.name: East tunnel
7421.description:
You are standing in dark tunnel, 出口s are east
and west. To the west you see a wooden door.

7422.name: North tunnel
7422.description: You are standing in a dark tunnel, it 通向上wards.

7423.name: The L-shaped room.
7423.description:
You are standing in deep 黑暗. To the south there is a small exit.
To the east 你能看到 a gaping hole.

7424.name: The Circular hall.
7424.description:
You are standing in round hall. To the north, east and south you
can see a stone head hanging on the walls.

7425.name: Dusty tunnel
7425.description:
You are standing in dust. This place has not been
touched for a long time. Otherwise it is quite boring
here, looks like a place to rest! To the west you see
the outline of a door. A tunnel leads 向东.

7426.name: The crossing
7426.description:
You are standing in a crossing of hallways. You can leave this place
in every direction, except up and down. In the dust you notice strange
footprints.

7427.name: The L-shaped room
7427.description:
You are standing in a L-shaped room. You can hear noises from the long
tunnel 向东. You can feel fear! A sign is hanging on the wall.

7428.name: Dragons lair
7428.description:
你能看到 burned walls, the floorstones are fiery red.  All kinds of bones
are scattered all over the floor.  On the walls 你能看到 some burned
shapes.  You 气味 burned flesh.  Two creatures are melted into the floor.
You're next.

7429.name: The burned room
7429.description:
你在 a room, which once had been quite burned.
There is writing on the wall.

7430.name: The wind tunnel
7430.description:
You are standing in a tunnel. Above you, you can feel
a breeze.

7431.name: The glittering room
7431.description:
This room are all bright. In the walls 你能看到 some
silver. Exits are: West, east and south.

7432.name: The secret passageroom
7432.description:
You have entered a tiny room. There WAS an exit down, and an
exit 向西.

7433.name: End of long tunnel
7433.description:
You are at a end of a long tunnel. Right in front of you,
你能看到 a grey mass. To the east 你能看到 a tremendous
long tunnel, but you know that, you has just been there.

7434.name: Stair-room
7434.description:
You are standing in a small room. Drawings of faces in pain
are on the walls. You can feel that 黑暗 is ruling this place.
there are two 出口: south and down. You have a feeling the downward exit
isn't finished yet...

7435.name: Dark tunnel
7435.description:
You are standing in a dark tunnel. It continues 向北
and 向南. Bones are spread on the floor

7436.name: Entrance to lair
7436.description:
气味 here is 糟糕的.  To the south 你能看到 some smoke.
A tunnel 通向北方, and east.

7437.name: North-eastern part of Basilisks cave
7437.description:
It is hard to see here because of the smoke. To the north you
can see barely see a small tunnel. Other 出口 are 向南
and 向西.

7438.name: South-eastern part of basilisks cave
7438.description:
There are a very small hole in wall, from where the smoke
are coming from. Otherwise it is pitch dark. Exits are north
and west.

7439.name: North-western part of basilisks cave
7439.description:
你能看到 some hay spread on the floor. 气味 is 糟糕的 here,
and it makes you feel sick.  The basilisk sleeps here.
Watch out ... Maybe it is not far away.

7440.name: South-western part of basilisks cave
7440.description: 你能看到 nothing but smoke.

7441.name: The small cave
7441.description:
You are standing in small cave. 你能看到
some light in the end. Exits are north and south.

7442.name: The northern end of the pool
7442.description:
You have wet feet, you are standing in water. The water looks calm. You can
see that it's a big lake. Light seeps from 水.

7443.name: The pool
7443.description: You are swimming in water. It is getting deep here. It is dark in this end.

7444.name: The south end of the pool
7444.description: 你站在ing in water up to you neck. You can only see water.

7445.name: The pool
7445.description:
You are swimming in DARKNESS. You feel something
touching your right leg.

3900.name: West trail around Midgaard
3900.description:
You are on a dusty trail following the outside wall of Midgaard.
To the east the wall towers over you and 向西 you see the
forest of Haon-Dor. The trail 通向北方 and south along the wall.

3901.name: West trail around Midgaard
3901.description:
You are on a dusty trail following the outside wall of Midgaard.
To the east the wall towers over you and 向西 you see the
forest of Haon-Dor. The trail 通向北方 and south along the wall.

3902.name: Northwest corner of dusty trail.
3902.description:
You are standing outside the northwestern corner of the city wall.
The trail 通向东方 following the north wall and south towards the gate.

3903.name: Dusty trail along north wall.
3903.description:
You are walking on the trail following the outside of Midgaard's
northern wall.

3904.name: The long dusty trail following the north wall.
3904.description:
You are just outside the northern gate of Midgaard.  You can continue along
the trail 向东 or west, head onwards to the plains of the north, or
enter Midgaard 向南.  You can just barely make out the buildings of
Midgaard from here, the Temple of Mota looks impressive even from this
distance.

3905.name: Dusty trail along north wall.
3905.description:
You are walking on the trail following the outside of Midgaard's
northern wall.

3906.name: Northeast corner of dusty trail.
3906.description:
You are standing outside the northeastern corner of the city wall.
The trail 通向西方 following the north wall and south towards the gate.

3907.name: East trail around Midgaard
3907.description:
You are on a dusty trail following the outside wall of Midgaard.
To the west the wall towers over you and far 向东 you see
some mountains. The trail 通向北方 and south along the wall.

3908.name: East trail around Midgaard
3908.description:
You are on a dusty trail following the outside wall of Midgaard.
To the west the wall towers over you and far 向东 you see
some mountains. The trail 通向北方 and south along the wall.

4000.name: The hills
4000.description:
You are on a small bewildered path winding its way between the hills in
lack of better things to do. To the south you have a splendid view over the
flat, vast, desolate plains. To the north the hills grow steadily 暗er and
foreboding. This is the cause of no sunset, it is rather the power of evil
penetrating these quiet hills. Glancing around you notice only a single bird.
The mountains of 矮人的 kingdom rise up to your east, you can barely
make out the queen's 矿坑s from here.

4001.name: The hills
4001.description:
You are surrounded by 暗 and sinister hills. Although they seemed fairly
small from a distance you now get the feeling that they're closing in on you,
towering over you, overwhelming you ...  The small path seems to have second
thoughts about these hills because it starts winding unnecessarily, turning
several times around itself.  To the south the hills have a lighter hue of
暗. To the north however, the hills have become nightblack holes in the
distant mountains.

4002.name: End of the path
4002.description:
At this point the path has had enough. With a terrified shudder it cowers
to the ground, only staying here because you're standing on it. with a slight
feeling of unease you look around noticing only a few bushes and a large sign
carved into the mountain.  You feel you can hear the cry of help from a
thousand silent voices all coming from an even 暗er hole in the mountain to
the north marking the entrance to a 洞穴 (or a grave :-).

4010.name: The 洞穴
4010.description:
你在 a large 洞穴. The ceiling is lost somewhere above the reach of
your light. The floor, however, is highly illuminated, your light flickering
over several tombstones. Only one is whole, the rest have been shattered by
some savage blow. The remaining tombstone looks disturbingly new...
A small breeze of fresh air enters from the south (probably lost too). Take a
good breath, it may be your last mouthful of air in a long, long time that
others haven't breathed before you.
To the north a small 隧道 continues into the mountain.

4011.name: The 隧道
4011.description:
You squeeze your way through a small, narrow 隧道. The sharp-edged rocks
protruding from the walls threaten to scratch and cut you. 
To the south you sense a freshness in the air which is rather unusual in these
damp, stuffy 隧道s. To the north 隧道 continues.

4012.name: The 隧道
4012.description:
你在 a part of 隧道 that looks uncannily like the rest except
that it goes in a east-north direction. To the north 隧道 widens into
a 洞穴.

4013.name: The 隧道
4013.description:
This 隧道, leading east-west, seems seldom used.  A thick layer of dust
covers the floor, making the air stuffy and dry.

4014.name: The 隧道
4014.description:
You are walking in a narrow 隧道. The walls are only roughly shaped,
sharp rocks protruding everywhere, even from the floor making you stumble in
the flickering light. To the south 隧道 narrows even more making it
almost impossible to pass. To the north it slowly widens into a 洞穴. There
is a branch of 隧道 going west.

4015.name: The 隧道
4015.description: 你在 a corner 隧道 leading west and north.

4016.name: The large 洞穴
4016.description:
你在 a large 洞穴, 洞穴 continues east and west, 向南
you notice a small 隧道.

4017.name: The large 洞穴
4017.description: 你在 the east end of the large 洞穴.

4018.name: The 洞穴
4018.description:
你在 the south end of a 洞穴, 向南 you see a 隧道. You
notice a large pile of bones in the corner.

4019.name: The 隧道
4019.description: 你在 a north-south leading 隧道.

4020.name: The hole
4020.description: You are by a hole in the floor, you can leave down, or north.

4021.name: The hole
4021.description: A hole in the floor leads down here.

4022.name: The damp 隧道
4022.description:
你在 a damp 隧道.  Your clothes feel wet.  隧道 continues
向北; 向西 you see a hole in the floor; and 向东
there is a large 洞穴.

4023.name: The large 洞穴
4023.description:
你在 the western part of the large 洞穴, 向南 you see
a damp 隧道.

4024.name: The damp 隧道
4024.description: 你在 a corner of a damp 隧道.  You can go west or south.

4025.name: The 洞穴
4025.description: 你在 the north end of a 洞穴.  To the east you see many 隧道s.

4026.name: The many 隧道s
4026.description: You are at the intersection of many 隧道s.

4027.name: The 隧道
4027.description:
你在 a north-south leading 隧道, you also notice a 隧道 to
the west. From the north you sense the fresh air!

4028.name: The smelly 隧道
4028.description:
你在 a north-south leading 隧道, you see a small light
向北. You notice a strange smell from the north..

4029.name: The 洞穴
4029.description:
你在 a 洞穴 that is filled with fresh air, you sense the
wind blowing from the north. To the south you see a small 隧道
continue into the mountain.

4030.name: The light 洞穴
4030.description:
你在 a light 洞穴, through a hole large above you, you see 
the sky. A small 隧道 向南 is the only way out.

4031.name: The valley
4031.description:
你在 a small valley, surrounded by hills and a mountain to 
the south. In the mountain there is a 洞穴.

4032.name: The foothills
4032.description:
You are on a winding path that leads through the foothills on the
other side of the mountain.  The path continues north.

4033.name: The intersection in the foothills
4033.description:
The small path you are following splits here.  The path continues
north and south or you can follow a trail east into the mountains.

4034.name: The grassy area of the foothills
4034.description:
The grass here is unusually high.  You notice several areas where
someone or something large has crushed spots of the grass down.  Several very
large rocks litter this area.  You can go north, west or south.

4035.name: The foothills end
4035.description:
At this point you are leaving the foothills.  You see a plains area
向北 of here.  You can spot a small city in the distance from
here.

4040.name: The mountain top.
4040.description: Exits are north, east, and west.

4050.name: The 隧道
4050.description: 隧道 turns here, continuing 向东 and south.

4051.name: The 隧道
4051.description: 你在 a narrow east-west 隧道.

4052.name: The 隧道
4052.description: You are at a turn, 隧道 continues south and west.

4053.name: The 隧道
4053.description: You are at a turn, 隧道 continues north and east.

4054.name: The light 洞穴
4054.description:
你在 a 洞穴, to south from you there is a large fire that lights
the entire 洞穴, 向东 and west 隧道s leads off.

4055.name: The maze
4055.description: 你在 a maze of small damp 隧道s.  The only exit is west.

4056.name: The light 洞穴
4056.description:
你在 a light 洞穴, a large fire in front of you lights 房间.
洞穴 continues 向北 and south.

4057.name: The maze
4057.description: 你在 a maze of small damp 隧道s.

4058.name: The maze
4058.description: 你在 a maze of small damp 隧道s.

4059.name: The 隧道
4059.description:
你在 a 隧道, only exit is 向东. You sense that the
隧道 leads slightly down.

4060.name: The 隧道
4060.description:
你在 a small 隧道, 向西 隧道 continues and 
向东 you see some light.

4061.name: The light 洞穴
4061.description: 你在 the south end of a light 洞穴.

4062.name: The maze
4062.description: 你在 a maze of small damp 隧道s.

4063.name: The maze
4063.description: 你在 a maze of small damp 隧道s.

4064.name: The 隧道
4064.description: You are at the eastern end of a 隧道.

4065.name: The maze
4065.description: 你在 a maze of small damp 隧道s.

4066.name: The maze
4066.description: 你在 a maze of small damp 隧道s.

4067.name: The maze
4067.description: 你在 a maze of small damp 隧道s.

4068.name: The large 洞穴
4068.description: 你在 the northwest end of a large 洞穴.

4069.name: The large 洞穴
4069.description:
你在 the northeast end of a large 洞穴. To the north the
is a small damp 隧道.

4070.name: The large 洞穴
4070.description: 你在 the southwest end of a large 洞穴.

4071.name: The large 洞穴
4071.description:
你在 the southeast end of a large 洞穴. To the east you
notice a small 隧道.

4072.name: The 隧道
4072.description:
你在 a narrow 隧道, which leads both 向东 and the
south. There is also an exit towards the west, where you see a large
洞穴.

4074.name: The hole
4074.description:
You are at a small hole in the floor, you can either leave north
or try your luck and leave down into the unknown!

4100.name: The 隧道
4100.description: Suddenly you feel that 隧道 leads slightly down.

4101.name: The long 隧道
4101.description:
你在 a long east-west leading 隧道. 隧道 is quite
wide at this point.

4102.name: The long 隧道
4102.description:
你在 a long east-west leading 隧道. 隧道 becomes
narrow 向西.

4103.name: The long 隧道
4103.description:
你在 a long east-west leading 隧道. 隧道 is quite
narrow at this point. You notice a small hole leading south.

4104.name: The long 隧道
4104.description:
你在 a long east-west leading 隧道. 隧道 starts sloping
down towards the west.

4105.name: The golden 洞穴
4105.description:
你在 a giant 洞穴, all the walls are shining with a soft golden
light. 洞穴 continues 向南 and west.

4106.name: The golden 洞穴
4106.description:
你在 a giant 洞穴, all the walls are shining with a soft golden
light. 洞穴 continues 向南 and east, 向北 is a narrow
隧道.

4107.name: The 通道
4107.description:
你在 a small 通道, it 通向南方, 向西 is a golden
洞穴.

4108.name: The golden 洞穴
4108.description:
你在 a giant 洞穴, all the walls are shining with a soft golden
light. 洞穴 continues 向北 and west, east from you there is
a small 通道.

4109.name: The golden 洞穴
4109.description:
你在 a giant 洞穴, all the walls are shining with a soft golden
light. 洞穴 continues 向南, east and north.

4110.name: The 隧道
4110.description: You are at the end of 隧道.

4111.name: The 隧道
4111.description: 你在 a small 隧道, it leads from east 向西.

4112.name: The 隧道
4112.description: 你在 a larger 隧道, it leads from west to east.

4113.name: The 通道
4113.description:
你在 a 通道 that leads towards the south. To the east 
you see a 隧道.

4114.name: The golden 洞穴
4114.description:
你在 a giant 洞穴, all the walls are shining with a soft golden
light. 洞穴 continues 向北, 向西 you see a 暗 
通道.

4115.name: The dark 通道.
4115.description:
你在 a 暗 通道, that 通向东方. In the ceiling you notice
a small hole, just big enough to pass through.

4116.name: The 通道
4116.description:
你在 a 通道 that 通向北方-south. You notice a small
light 向南.

4117.name: The secret 房间
4117.description: 你在 a secret 房间.

4118.name: The 洞穴
4118.description:
你在 a light 洞穴, from t兽人hes several feet above your
head fire lights 房间. 洞穴 continues 向西 and south.
To the north a small hole leads to a 隧道.

4119.name: The 洞穴
4119.description:
你在 a light 洞穴, from t兽人hes several feet above your
head fire lights 房间. 洞穴 continues 向东 and south.

4120.name: The 通道
4120.description: 你在 a north-south leading 通道. To the south you see light.

4121.name: The secret 隧道
4121.description:
你在 a secret 隧道 that 通向西方, you feel evilness
approaching you as you continue west.

4122.name: The secret 房间
4122.description:
你在 a secret 房间, 房间 is filled with an evil
feeling.

4123.name: The 洞穴
4123.description:
你在 a light 洞穴, from t兽人hes several feet above your
head fire lights 房间. 洞穴 continues 向北 and west.

4124.name: The 洞穴
4124.description:
你在 a light 洞穴, from t兽人hes several feet above your
head fire lights 房间. 洞穴 continues 向东 and north.
To the west a 通道 通向北方.

4125.name: The 通道
4125.description:
你在 a 通道, 向东 you see a 洞穴. Light from the
洞穴 lights up 通道. To the north 通道 leads into
黑暗.

4150.name: The dark hole
4150.description:
You are standing at a hole, a small 通道 通向南方. You see
some inscriptions on the wall, most of 'em the usual stuff, like:
'Super Snude was here' and 'Why does the mayor likes secretaries with
small hands?' - But one inscription gets your attention, it says:
The Balrog is ALIVE ...

4151.name: The small 通道
4151.description:
你在 a small 通道, 向北 you see a hole, and to
the south you see a large 隧道. The air is damp in this area.

4152.name: The 隧道
4152.description: You suddenly feel that 隧道 leads down.

4153.name: The large 隧道
4153.description:
你在 a large 隧道 leading from the south 向东. The
air is damp in the area.

4154.name: The large 隧道
4154.description:
你在 a large east-west leading 隧道, the air is damp and
the floor is wet.

4155.name: The large 隧道
4155.description:
你在 a large 隧道, 隧道 通向西方, and 向东
you notice a long 隧道. The air is damp in this area.

4156.name: The long 隧道
4156.description: You are standing in a long north-south 隧道.

4157.name: The wet 隧道
4157.description:
你在 a wet, north-south leading 隧道, the floor is
partly covered by water.

4158.name: The small maze
4158.description:
你在 a small maze, exits leads off 向东,  south
and west. The floor is partly covered by water.

4159.name: The small maze
4159.description:
你在 a small maze, exits leads off only 向南
and west. The air is damp in this maze.

4160.name: In the 隧道 at the inscription
4160.description:
你在 a north-south leading 隧道, the air is damp. On
the wall there is an inscription.

4161.name: The wet 隧道
4161.description:
你在 a north-south leading 隧道.  The floor is fully
covered by water.

4162.name: The small maze
4162.description:
你在 a small maze. The floor is mainly covered by
water, exits 通向北方, east and south.

4163.name: The small maze
4163.description:
你在 a small maze, where the air is damp. Exits
leads 向北 and east.

4164.name: The entrance to the small maze
4164.description:
你在 a north-south leading 隧道, and the air is damp.
To the west you see a small maze.

4165.name: In the water
4165.description:
You are standing in water, 隧道 continues both to the
north and south.

4166.name: The wet maze
4166.description:
你在 a part of the maze where the floor is fully covered
by water. The maze continues 向北, east and south.

4167.name: The wet maze
4167.description:
你在 a small maze, the floor is covered by water, the
maze continues east, west and south.

4168.name: The end of the 隧道
4168.description:
隧道 suddenly stops here, only exit is 向西.
The air is damp here.

4169.name: In the water
4169.description: You are standing in the water, exits leads both north and east.

4170.name: In the water
4170.description: You are standing in the water, it continues east and west.

4171.name: End of maze
4171.description:
You are at the end of the small maze which continues north.
Above you a hole leads up.

4172.name: At the sand bar
4172.description: You are on a little sand bar in the water.
